block_event.event: each half has a unique largest open cluster and the two largest clusters belong to one open cluster in Re
block_event.geometry: two adjacent s-by-s cells Su,Sv with union Re of size 2s-by-s
block_event.lifting: an infinite open block path forces an infinite original open cluster
block_event.locality: the event depends only on sites in Re
block_event.renormalized_dependence: events for vertex-disjoint block bonds use disjoint rectangles, hence define a 1-independent bond model on Z2

deterministic_constants.modern_use: reject H0: block-event probability<=0.8457; strict rejection certifies >0.8457

error_budget.allocation: Bonferroni over three upper-bound and three matching-lattice lower-bound runs

feasibility_decision.deterministic_enumeration: naive enumeration is exponential in O(s^2), while frontier transfer is exponential in s; neither is a plausible route at production scales
feasibility_decision.production_gate: first implement and independently validate the exact block event; use exploratory samples only to freeze s and p; then draw fresh final IID samples under the declared error budget
feasibility_decision.reason: the method applies directly and the statistical certificate is cheap, but the block event needs a new open-boundary evaluator and geometric scale dominates cost; a 5e-4 interval was already achieved in 2007

heuristic_cost_model.assumption: thermal window scales as s^(-3/4), per-trial work as area s^2
heuristic_cost_model.certification_status: not part of the rigorous guarantee

randomness_boundary.deterministic_claim: no deterministic new pc bound is produced by this artifact
randomness_boundary.pseudorandom_generator: software reproducibility and stream-domain separation do not by themselves prove genuine randomness
randomness_boundary.statistical_theorem: conditional on independent trials from genuine Bernoulli site fields

sources.role: block event, 1-independent reduction, exact binomial test, and 2007 interval

two_sided_square_site_interval.final_confidence: at least 1-familywise_alpha under predeclared tests and IID genuine Bernoulli trials
two_sided_square_site_interval.lower: at parameter q, run the same upper-bound protocol on the square-site matching graph; then pc(square)>=1-q by site matching duality
two_sided_square_site_interval.upper: at parameter p, reject block-event probability<=p0 on square-site Z2; then report pc(square)<=p
